sql: SELECT t.protocol, t.status, t.channel, c.name AS customer, count(m.id)::int AS messages FROM "Ticket" t JOIN "Customer" c ON c.id = t."customerId" JOIN "Message" m ON m."ticketId" = t.id WHERE t.protocol = $1 GROUP BY t.protocol, t.status, t.channel, c.name
